book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: كان في شحاد أعرج بالضيعة من صغره.
sentences.en: There was a lame beggar in the village from his childhood.

sentences.ar: الناس اعتادوا عليه وصاروا يمرقوا عنه.
sentences.en: People got used to him and began passing him by.

sentences.ar: بيوم شتوي، ما لقى ولا لقمة.
sentences.en: On a winter day, he found not one mouthful.

sentences.ar: مشي على أربع ضياع وكلهم سكروا الأبواب.
sentences.en: He walked to four villages and all of them shut their doors.
In the end, he found a hen in a field and took her.

sentences.ar: أكلها ونام تحت شجرة وهو شبعان لأول مرة.
sentences.en: He ate her and slept under a tree, full for the first time.
In the morning, the police came and took him.
They locked him in a small room and shut the door.

sentences.ar: تاني يوم، فتحوا الباب ولقوه ميت.
sentences.en: The next day, they opened the door and found him dead.

sentences.ar: واحد منهم قال: عجيب، كان لسا عايش امبارح.
sentences.en: One of them said: strange, he was alive only yesterday.
